rows.title: Fires only on airline-refund messages
rows.defect: the not-ours and cancel-imperative exclusions are skipped
rows.test: a travel-insurance claim on a cancelled flight stays null

rows.title: Domestic change boundary
rows.defect: off by one: a change of exactly the limit counts
rows.test: exactly 3 hours is not owed, 3h01m is

rows.title: International change boundary
rows.defect: international flights are held to the domestic limit
rows.test: 6 hours international is not owed; 5 hours is not either

rows.title: The fare from the right row
rows.defect: amount from the wrong row: the airline filter is dropped, so any charge can be the fare
rows.test: the Delta fare, not the bag fee or United's fare

rows.title: Voucher warning
rows.test: the warning shows before a voucher is accepted

rows.title: Missing facts asked, never assumed
rows.defect: an unknown decision is treated as declined
rows.test: a cancelled flight with no decision asks, and claims nothing

rows.title: Domestic bag boundary
rows.defect: off by one: a bag at exactly the limit counts as late
rows.test: exactly 12 hours is within the limit

rows.title: International bag limits
rows.defect: the shortest international limit is used as if it were the longest

rows.title: Paid extras not delivered
rows.defect: an extra that worked badly is treated as not delivered
rows.test: slow Wi-Fi is asked about, not claimed

rows.title: Bump short band
rows.defect: off by one: exactly 1 hour late gets nothing

rows.title: Stale terms say so
rows.defect: the stale cite is dropped: terms are cited as current whatever their age
rows.test: a year past the check, every cite says it may have changed

rows.title: The person sends it
rows.defect: the reply claims Upmore sent the request
rows.test: the reply says nothing has been sent

rows.title: 7 business days
rows.defect: weekends are counted as business days
rows.test: Oct 1 plus 7 business days is Oct 12

rows.title: Complaint only after the watch date
rows.defect: complaint text on the watch date itself
rows.test: on the due date, no complaint text
